hook: These fifteen goals are fighting for the Puskás Award. Number one was scored from his own half.

items.label: Spurs Sniper
items.line: Beating Gianluigi Donnarumma is already a flex. Doing it with a finish good enough to enter the Puskás conversation? That's how Dominic Solanke sneaks onto this list.
items.clip_hint: Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) goal beating Gianluigi Donnarumma, ~Feb 1 2026. WATCH IT FIRST and confirm it's the right goal.

items.label: Atlético Closer
items.line: A strike that won the match for Atlético. Defender's job description says stop goals. Nahuel Molina read it, laughed, and decided to win the game himself.
items.line_short: Defender energy, striker finish, match winner.

items.label: Crossbar Kiss
items.line: From long range, off the crossbar and in, to make it one-nil for Barça. The crossbar got the assist. João Cancelo got the aura.
items.line_short: Long range, off the bar and in. The crossbar assisted.
items.clip_hint: João Cancelo (Barcelona) long-range goal off the crossbar for 1-0, ~Sep 2026

items.label: Impossible Angle
items.line: There was no angle. Genuinely none. Michael Folorunsho looked at the byline, looked at the goal, and decided geometry is just a suggestion.
items.line_short: No angle. Geometry is a suggestion.
items.clip_hint: Michael Folorunsho goal from an extremely acute angle, Parma vs Cagliari, ~Feb 28 2026

items.label: Fulham Hammer
items.line: Last minute. Against Liverpool. From about thirty yards, into the top corner. Harrison Reed picked the biggest moment and the hardest shot, and absolutely nailed both.
items.line_short: Last minute vs Liverpool. Thirty yards. Top corner.
items.clip_hint: Harrison Reed (Fulham) last-minute long-range strike vs Liverpool, Premier League, Jan 4 2026

items.label: Outside Boot
items.line: Turns inside, turns back, then finishes with the outside of the boot like it's a Sunday kickabout. Christantus Uche in the Conference League. Pure disrespect.
items.line_short: Turn, turn, outside of the boot. Disrespectful.
items.clip_hint: Christantus Uche (Crystal Palace) vs KuPS, Conference League, Dec 18 2025

items.label: Benfica Rabona
items.line: A rabona. In a real league game. Rafa Silva pulled off the trick most of us only try in the backyard, and it actually went in.
items.line_short: Rabona in a real game. And it went in.
items.clip_hint: Rafa Silva (Benfica) rabona goal vs AVS, ~Feb 21 2026

items.label: Center-Back Rabona
items.line: Plot twist: this one's a center back. Scoring a rabona. Driss El Jabali woke up, ignored his position, and chose striker mode. Respect.
items.line_short: A center back. Scoring a rabona. Why not.
items.clip_hint: Driss El Jabali (MAS Fès) rabona vs Wydad AC, Botola Pro, Apr 12 2026

items.label: MLS Scissor Kick
items.line: Back to goal, over his shoulder, past Hugo Lloris. Zavier Gozo just put MLS on the Puskás map. Salt Lake, stand up.
items.line_short: Back to goal, over the shoulder, past Lloris. MLS, stand up.
items.clip_hint: Zavier Gozo (Real Salt Lake) over-the-shoulder scissor-kick volley vs LAFC, MLS, Sep 17 2025

items.label: Crossbar Volley
items.line: First time, from outside the box, off the bar and in, against Mamelodi Sundowns. Cemran Dansin hit this so clean it sounds illegal.
items.line_short: First-time volley, off the bar, in. Sounds illegal.
items.clip_hint: Cemran Dansin first-time volley vs Mamelodi Sundowns, South African Premiership, Nov 1 2025

items.label: Header to Bicycle
items.line: Bad clearance. He controls it with his head, then finishes with an overhead kick. Isaque turned somebody else's mistake into his own highlight reel.
items.line_short: Head control, then overhead kick. Mistake to masterpiece.
items.clip_hint: Isaque (Shakhtar Donetsk) overhead kick vs Lech Poznań, Conference League, Mar 12 2026

items.label: England Heartbreaker
items.line: World Cup quarterfinal. Tough angle. Over Jordan Pickford's head and into the far corner. Norway's Andreas Schjelderup broke English hearts with one swing.
items.line_short: World Cup quarterfinal, over Pickford, far corner. Heartbreak.
items.clip_hint: Andreas Schjelderup (Norway) vs England, World Cup 2026 quarterfinal, Jul 11 2026

items.label: Extra Time Ice
items.line: Extra time, one-one, World Cup quarterfinal, and Julián Álvarez finds the corner from the edge of the box. That's not nerves. That's ice in the veins.
items.line_short: Extra time, World Cup quarterfinal, edge of the box. Ice cold.
items.clip_hint: Julián Álvarez (Argentina) extra-time goal from the edge of the box vs Switzerland, World Cup 2026 quarterfinal, Jul 12 2026

items.label: Cape Verde Hero
items.line: Cape Verde. Against Argentina. At a World Cup. He cuts inside past Mac Allister and bends it over Emi Martínez. Tiny nation, giant goal.
items.line_short: Cape Verde vs Argentina. Cuts in, bends it over Emi. Giant goal.
items.clip_hint: Sidny Lopes Cabral (Cape Verde) vs Argentina, World Cup 2026 (sources disagree on the stage: CHECK before using)

items.label: 68-Meter Lob
items.line: Sixty-eight meters. He spots the keeper off his line and lobs him from his own half. Arda Güler didn't take a shot, he made a decision from another planet. Number one.
items.line_short: Sixty-eight meters. From his own half. Number one.
items.clip_hint: Arda Güler (Real Madrid) 68-meter lob over Matías Dituro vs Elche, La Liga, Mar 14 2026

outro: Which one should win the Puskás? Comment your pick, and subscribe for the official nominees ranking.
